main.description: Fetch one place by its record key.

uri.description: The record's key: its origin, or its own uri when it has none, e.g. urn:atgeo:openstreetmap.org:way:123456

errors.name: PlaceNotFound
errors.description: This server serves no place with that key

uri.description: The record key this view is for, as requested: the place's origin.

url.description: The address of this view on this server; it returns this same document.

importance.description: The producer's importance score for this place among its tileset's records; larger values sort first. Scores are comparable across the tilesets one producer builds from one dataset, and meaningless across producers. Not part of the place.

attribution.description: One entry for every collection the place's tileset carries or references: the same list every tile of that tileset carries.
